0022600123.text: The Milwaukee Bucks, who are 0-3 and on a three-game losing streak, are 13th in the East and 5th in the Central, 3 games back, with an 0-1 home record and an 0-2 road record. The Indiana Pacers are 2-1, sit 2nd in the Central and 5th in the East, and have won their last game, but they are missing five players: Andrew Nembhard (back soreness), Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, but the Bucks won 4-0 against Indiana in 2025-26, including a 134-123 win in Milwaukee on March 15, 2026.
